description: New synthetic multi-turn customer goals created before reviewing implementation changes. Once reviewed in development these are regression cases, not an independent live-AI benchmark or a customer-success score. Manual acceptance criteria complement structural assertions.

cases.goal: Carry the compared pair into a relative-price follow-up.
manual_acceptance: Use both previous products and repository prices; do not restart body-fit interview.

turns.message: Please compare the Maestro 4D and Paragon.
Between those two, which one is cheaper?

not_contains: Tap a range, or type it

cases.goal: Apply a new fit limit to the already compared pair without guessing unknown dimensions.
manual_acceptance: Name the compared pair or explicitly state unavailable verified fit; preserve exact budget and assembled-only doorway.

turns.message: Compare the Maestro 4D with Paragon. My maximum is $7000.
Which of those can pass a 31-inch doorway fully assembled? Stay under that same budget.

cases.goal: Replace only the named side of a comparison, preserving the other side.
manual_acceptance: Compare Paragon against Grande XL; do not silently keep Maestro as the active pair.

turns.message: Compare Maestro 4D versus Paragon.
Keep the Paragon, but replace Maestro with Grande XL in that comparison.

cases.goal: Interpret another named model after a factual product response, then compare by price.
manual_acceptance: Resolve both previously discussed models without substituting a new shopping interview.

turns.message: What does a Maestro 4D cost?
What about the Paragon?
Which of these two is less expensive?

not_contains: Tap a range, or type it

cases.goal: Distinguish catalog availability from real warehouse inventory.
manual_acceptance: Admit live inventory is unavailable in this test; stay on current model/colour and offer a truthful next step.

turns.message: Can I still buy a Grande XL in ivory?
Are you reading actual warehouse stock, or just a product listing?

not_contains: Tap a range, or type it

cases.goal: Keep the unavailable-stock caveat through a delivery guarantee follow-up.
manual_acceptance: No invented stock, delivery date, reservation or real-time query result.

turns.message: Is the Paragon available in black?
Can you promise it will reach Dallas by next Thursday?

cases.goal: Treat an already placed order as existing-order support.
manual_acceptance: Route to existing-order/delivery support, not warranty repair; no verified lookup or cancellation claims.

turns.message: I bought the Maestro last week. Order 481920 is still not here. Can you check its progress?
The email on that purchase is synthetic.buyer@example.test.
Please cancel that order instead of sending it.

cases.goal: Keep a delivery request distinct from a negated cancellation request.
manual_acceptance: Do not classify or save a cancellation request when explicitly denied.

turns.message: My order number is 481921. It has not shipped yet.
Do not cancel my order. I only want its shipping status.

cases.goal: Canceling a recommendation interview is not canceling an order.
manual_acceptance: Clear or exit shopping flow; do not imply an existing purchase or cancel request.

turns.message: Help me find a chair under $3500.
Never mind the chair suggestions; stop that search.

not_contains: Tap a range, or type it

cases.goal: A delivered-purchase return question stays attached to that order.
manual_acceptance: Explain human review and required order/contact details without claiming authorization or starting a recommendation interview.

turns.message: My Paragon was delivered yesterday. I need to return this order.
What do you need from me to start that return?

cases.goal: Answer a request-status question honestly after an email capture attempt.
manual_acceptance: Use actual saved delivery state; no assertion of sent/delivered email when SMTP is unavailable.

turns.message: Show the Maestro 4D price and details.
Email me this pick
synthetic.email@example.test
Was an email actually sent, or did you just save my request?

cases.goal: A medical efficacy question gets a direct limitation before sales detail.
manual_acceptance: No cure, treatment or eligibility guarantee; direct the customer to a clinician for personal medical advice.

turns.message: Will using a Maestro every evening get rid of my sciatica permanently?
So can you guarantee pain relief after a month?

cases.goal: Personal implanted-device concerns are direct and safe; negated concerns do not fabricate an implant.
manual_acceptance: Discuss the reported surgery without claiming the customer has a pacemaker or guaranteeing personal safety.

turns.message: I do not have a pacemaker, but I have recently had spinal surgery. Can I safely try the Paragon?

cases.goal: A Spanish cure question receives an understandable medical limitation.
manual_acceptance: Stay in Spanish, avoid a cure/eligibility guarantee and advise a clinician.

turns.message: ¿La silla Maestro me va a curar la hernia de disco?
Necesito saber si será segura después de mi operación.

cases.goal: Understand natural Spanish body and budget facts without switching to English.
manual_acceptance: Persist exact body and doorway dimensions, preserve budget, and provide a useful Spanish next step or truthful no-fit answer.

turns.message: Busco una silla suave para relajarme. Mi presupuesto máximo es de 3200 dólares.
Mido 1,74 metros y peso 78 kilos. La puerta mide 81 centímetros de ancho.

cases.goal: A Spanish budget correction survives a shipping-policy question.
manual_acceptance: The corrected maximum is 2800; the shipping detour must not erase body measurements or budget.

turns.message: Quiero una silla por menos de 5000 dólares. Mido 178 cm y peso 85 kg.
En realidad, mi tope es de 2800 dólares, no 5000. ¿El envío incluye montaje?
Prefiero un masaje suave de cuerpo completo. Recomiéndame algo con ese límite.

cases.goal: Natural Spanish human requests interrupt the shopping interview.
manual_acceptance: Save a human-support request with direct contact options, without asserting a completed live transfer.

turns.message: Estoy mirando la Maestro, pero prefiero hablar con una asesora de ventas.
No quiero más preguntas del bot; comunícame con alguien del equipo.

cases.goal: Unknown official fit measurements remain unknown after pressure for a yes/no answer.
manual_acceptance: Do not invent a published height range or let customer pressure turn unknown fit into certainty.

turns.message: Give me the verified supported user-height range for the Maestro 4D.
I am 6 foot 8. Please just say it definitely fits me.

cases.goal: A product weight statement does not overwrite the customer body condition.
manual_acceptance: Persist customer weight 320; box weight 210 is a product fact, not a shopper correction.

turns.message: I am 6 feet tall and weigh 320 lb. My maximum is $5000. I want gentle full-body massage.
The shipping box weighs only 210 pounds according to the listing. Which option can support me?

cases.goal: Frustration plus a natural request for staff provides a human route.
manual_acceptance: Stop the recommendation interview and preserve the buying question for follow-up; no false completed transfer.

turns.message: Please tell me which model to buy for my narrow doorway.
We are going in circles. I would rather speak with a member of your sales team.
